entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Sarah at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Mark Sterling. The order is for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Thank you, Mr. Sterling. I see your recent order here. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's fine. I just don't want it. I tried to return it a few days ago, but your website decided not to work.
I'm sorry to hear that, and I do apologize for any trouble with our site. When did you attempt to process the return?
Last Friday. It was a complete website error. I assume the whole system was down because I couldn't print the label or even submit the form.

I understand your frustration. Let me check our system status for last Friday... Yes, I can confirm we had a known outage with our returns portal then. My apologies for that inconvenience. Just for our records, were you able to get a screenshot of the error?
No. I figured you'd know if your own system was broken. I just gave up.
Not a problem at all, Mr. Sterling. The system alert is right here, so that's all the verification I need. Let me just review the policy for your item.
Okay, I've checked everything. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, and you are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you.

I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. And Mr. Sterling, I see you're a VIP customer. To thank you for your patience with the portal issue, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase. We do appreciate your business.
Whatever. The credit is fine, I guess. Just make sure the label arrives.
It's on its way now. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, the full refund will be processed to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good afternoon.
